excerpt: In spite of all the creative brilliance and extremely talented people, they still needed someone to make sense of the chaos, connect the dots, and help move it all forward. That is no small thing and it is exactly what operations means.

The problem is usually not effort. It is alignment. Most teams are not stuck because people are not working hard. They are stuck because everyone is working hard on slightly different versions of the same goal.
Alignment is one of those things that feels obvious until you are in the middle of a team that does not have it. Then it becomes the only thing you can think about.
I am a baker at heart. It turns out baking and operations have more in common than you would think. Both are about creating the right conditions, not just hoping for a good result.
